items.title: Pay annual gas bill balance
items.quote: Bitte gleichen Sie diese Rechnung binnen 30 Kalendertagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum aus; Teilzahlungen sind nach Absprache möglich.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) = 27.11.2026. The period is 30 calendar days 'nach dem Rechnungsdatum', so per §187(1) BGB the day of the event (27.11.) is not counted; the period starts on 28.11.2026 (day 1). Counting 30 calendar days: Nov 28-30 = days 1-3, Dec 1-27 = days 4-30, so the 30th day is 27.12.2026. That date is a Sunday, and per §193 BGB, when the last day of a period falls on a Sunday, Saturday, or public holiday, the period ends on the next working day. 28.12.2026 is a Monday and not a public holiday in NRW (Christmas holidays are Dec 25-26), so the due date shifts to 28.12.2026.
